runtime-import-binding.label: Independent decision on the exact prepared candidate, contract, result and inputs

private_opinion_digest_scope: SHA256 of the privately retained UTF-8 opinion text with final LF; not a host-message envelope or authenticated transport receipt
transport_note: Full candidate and evidence were literally supplied to both persistent tool-less reviewers; private copies and corrections are retained. File and response digests do not authenticate host-message transport or reviewer identity.
limitations: Separate runtime-import-binding decision for C01v2 only: six of 393 sources; C02 is outside this candidate.
Source baseline and runtime implementation pin are distinct. No Omni product tests, platform validation, complete CI, release or global integration acceptance is established.
Governed publication was not run in the reviewed evidence. Fresh candidate equality, normal governed checks and the stated full runtime-file recheck remain future publication requirements.
The auxiliary manifest-at-prepare is a mapping snapshot, not a live guarded input.
Nominal policy/actor/reviewer labels and private-opinion digests do not establish cryptographic identity or human acceptance.
This does not release complete L1, later layers or independent ownership-consumer cases.
Original private exchanges and reserved material are withheld; no public reproducibility of withheld material is claimed.
